name: Helen Maslen Scholarship
summary: Scholarship for UON students who have come to higher education as part of surviving domestic violence.
key: A benefit of $5,000, paid as $2,500 each semester.
who: Enrolled or enrolling in an enabling, undergraduate or postgraduate program
Accessed higher education as part of surviving domestic violence
Able to show educational disadvantage and satisfactory academic progress
how: Apply through the online portal with a personal statement and a letter of support (PDF uploads only)

source.label: University of Newcastle: Helen Maslen Scholarship

evidence.quote: This scholarship provides a benefit of $5,000, paid as $2,500 each semester.
Have accessed higher education as part of a process for surviving domestic violence.
